## Yimeng Cao

I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Biostatistics at Columbia University. My background is in data science, applied mathematics, and healthcare analytics. I am particularly interested in applying statistical methods to real-world data.

Previously, I worked on a research project at Pace University using the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) to examine the association between meditation and verbal fluency among older adults. I also worked with a postdoctoral researcher at UCLA Anderson on a project using General Social Survey (GSS) data to study racial disparities in workplace exploitation. Both projects involved statistical modeling and data analysis using R and Python.

## Research and Professional Interests

- Biostatistics and Epidemiology
- Healthcare Data Science and Real-World Evidence
- Machine Learning and Predictive Modeling
- Business Analytics and Decision Science
- Commercial Analytics and Business Strategy
- Financial Analytics and Forecasting
